message.content: On April 10th, 2026, during their discussion, WolfgangSchulz suggested trying out a new app that could help improve his drumming technique. LiHua and Yuriko were both open to exploring this new tool and even considered using it during their upcoming jam session. However, the main topic of discussion was about song selection for their jam session. WolfgangSchulz proposed playing something upbeat, possibly including classic Beatles tracks, and mixing in some classic rock as well. YurikoYamamoto added that they could also include holiday classics, suggesting "Last Christmas" and "Jingle Bells." While the exact song was not decided upon, the group agreed to explore these options and potentially create a fun, mixed arrangement of these songs during their jam session.
